title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Fee Assessment Standard: Late Fees
content:
**When a late fee is assessed.** A late fee is assessed on a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account when the payments credited with a transaction date on or after the statement date and on or before the payment due date add up to less than that statement's minimum payment due.

**Time condition.** The payment due date of the statement has passed, as the statement record shows. The fee is assessed on the calendar day after the payment due date (1 calendar day after it), which is the first day on which the minimum can no longer be met on time; a payment credited on the due date itself is on time.

**Amount.** The base fee is the card's repeat late fee when at least one earlier late fee is found in the lookback, and the card's first late fee otherwise; the fee charged is the lower of that base fee and the minimum payment due of the missed statement. The lookback is the card's late fee lookback number of statement periods immediately preceding the billing period of the missed payment (that period itself excluded); the late fees counted there are those belonging to a period in the lookback that carry no reversal for a fee assessed in error.

**When no late fee is assessed.** No late fee is assessed when the minimum payment due was 0.00, when the only shortfall is an amount under open billing dispute, or when a returned payment fee was already assessed for the same missed minimum payment.

**Period.** The fee belongs to the billing period of the missed statement.

## Boundary of the due date (hypothetical due date the 28th)

| Payment credited | On time | Late fee |
|---|---|---|
| the 28th, covering the minimum | yes | none |
| the 29th | no | assessed on the 29th if the minimum was not met by the 28th |

## Fee in figures (hypothetical card: first fee USD 32.00, repeat fee USD 43.00, lookback 6 periods)

| Earlier late fees in the 6 preceding periods | Minimum payment due of the missed statement | Fee charged |
|---|---|---|
| none | USD 60.00 | USD 32.00 |
| one, never reversed | USD 60.00 | USD 43.00 |
| one, reversed as assessed in error | USD 60.00 | USD 32.00 |
| one, reversed as a courtesy | USD 60.00 | USD 43.00 |
| none | USD 25.00 | USD 25.00 |

A late fee belonging to the seventh period back lies outside a 6-period lookback.
